children: Sweden's National Institute of Economic Research (NIER) on Wednesday raised its forecast GDP growth for 2026 and lowered that for next year.

The NIER, a government agency, said in a statement it now sees economic growth at 3.0% in 2026 and at 2.4% in 2027. Its previous forecasts, from August, were for growth of 2.4% and 2.8%, respectively.
